record.name: Montenegro
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A May 2025 UNDP readiness assessment, made with the government's Central Digital Office, reviews the state's readiness to use AI; no national AI institute or testing body was found.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

searches.query: Montenegro AI safety institute government strategy
Crna Gora vještačka inteligencija institut bezbjednost strategija

check.language_note: The recorded cnr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: ME-search = searches 1, 2 (en, cnr). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: UNDP produced the readiness assessment with the government Central Digital Office. The government working group is not an independently corroborating origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: The government working-group account describes finalising the 2026-2030 national AI strategy and its coordination process.

record.notes:
Only the earlier report's landing page, introduction and summary were read, not its full text.

A government working-group meeting on 27 May 2026 continued work on the national AI strategy for 2026-2030 and domestic AI capacity. Searches covered indexed public English and Montenegrin sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
